{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "High burden of vital signs at every visit",
      "quote": "Vital Signsh | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Vital signs are collected at every visit including all weekly visits and Q3W visits, which is excessive and burdensome for patients and staff, especially when many visits are for treatment only.",
      "fix": "Reduce vital sign frequency to visits where clinically indicated, e.g., only on dosing days or when symptoms occur."
    },
    {
      "title": "Adverse Event Monitoring and Concomitant Medications collected at every visit including follow-up",
      "quote": "Adverse Event Monitoring | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "AE and concomitant medication monitoring is required at every visit including long-term survival follow-up phone calls, which is impractical and burdensome for sites and patients over years of follow-up.",
      "fix": "Limit AE and concomitant medication collection to treatment visits and specified follow-up visits, not every LTSFU call."
    },
    {
      "title": "Clinical Laboratory Tests at every weekly visit and Q3W visit",
      "quote": "Clinical Laboratory Tests (hematology, serum chemistry, urinalysis)l | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |  | X | X | X",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Full lab panel (hematology, chemistry, urinalysis) is required at every weekly visit and every Q3W visit, which is excessive and burdensome for patients, especially those with difficult venous access.",
      "fix": "Reduce lab frequency to every other week or only when clinically indicated, and consider point-of-care testing."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory Biomarker Sampling at multiple visits including W6D2 and W7D1",
      "quote": "Exploratory Biomarker Sampling |  | X |  |  |  | X | X | X | X",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Biomarker sampling is required at W1D1, W5D1, W6D1, W6D2, and W7D1, which is a high frequency of extra blood draws, adding to patient burden and site workload.",
      "fix": "Consolidate biomarker sampling to fewer timepoints, e.g., only at W1D1 and W7D1, or align with PK sampling."
    },
    {
      "title": "Pharmacokinetic Sampling at W6D2 and W7D1 may be hard to collect",
      "quote": "Pharmacokinetic Sampling |  | X |  |  |  |  | X | X | X",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "PK sampling on consecutive days (W6D1, W6D2, W7D1) is burdensome and may be difficult for patients to attend, especially if they travel long distances.",
      "fix": "Reduce PK sampling to a single post-dose timepoint per cycle or use sparse PK sampling."
    },
    {
      "title": "Tumor Biopsy at W5D1 may be difficult to schedule and invasive",
      "quote": "Tumor Biopsyq | X |  |  |  |  | X",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "On-treatment tumor biopsy at W5D1 is invasive and may be challenging for sites to perform, especially if the tumor is not easily accessible, and adds significant patient burden.",
      "fix": "Consider making the on-treatment biopsy optional or allow collection at a more convenient timepoint."
    },
    {
      "title": "Disease Assessment (photographic imaging) at W1D1 may be redundant",
      "quote": "Disease Assessment (photographic imaging)r | X | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |  | X",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Photographic imaging at W1D1 (baseline) and again at EOT may be redundant if standard radiographic imaging is already performed; adds time and burden.",
      "fix": "Remove photographic imaging at W1D1 or combine with other imaging assessments."
    },
    {
      "title": "Thyroid Function Tests at W3D1 and W7D1 may be unnecessary",
      "quote": "Thyroid Function Testsl | X |  |  | X |  |  |  |  | X | X | X",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Thyroid function tests are performed at W3D1 and W7D1 in addition to Q3W visits, which may be excessive given that thyroid abnormalities are typically monitored less frequently.",
      "fix": "Align thyroid function testing with Q3W visits only, or reduce to every other cycle."
    }
  ]
}
